user.title: Add a Hadron webhook
user.description: Paste the trigger URL printed by `hadron webhook create` (or the Hadron portal). The platform token (hpt) is shown once alongside it — paste it here, or leave the token field empty if it is already embedded in the URL as `?hpt=…`.

error.invalid_url: This is not a Hadron trigger URL — expected https://SERVER/hooks/SECRET/NAME.
error.token_required: No platform token found. Paste the hpt token shown when the webhook was created (or rotate the webhook to get a new one).

abort.already_configured: This Hadron webhook is already configured.

data.enable_callback: Request a result callback by default (needs an externally reachable Home Assistant URL)
